mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO funnel_event (tenant_id, event_type, user_id, role, product_id, category, ai_assisted, scene, biz_id, event_key, create_time) VALUES (#{e.tenantId}, #{e.eventType}, #{e.userId}, #{e.role}, #{e.productId}, #{e.category}, #{e.aiAssisted}, #{e.scene}, #{e.bizId}, #{e.eventKey}, NOW())

INSERT IGNORE INTO funnel_event (tenant_id, event_type, user_id, role, product_id, category, ai_assisted, scene, biz_id, event_key, create_time) VALUES
(#{it.tenantId}, #{it.eventType}, #{it.userId}, #{it.role}, #{it.productId}, #{it.category}, #{it.aiAssisted}, #{it.scene}, #{it.bizId}, #{it.eventKey}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, event_type AS eventType, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM funnel_event WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY statDate, eventType ORDER BY statDate DESC, eventType

SELECT event_type AS eventType, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM funnel_event WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY eventType

SELECT e.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName FROM funnel_event e JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND e.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY e.tenant_id, t.tenant_name ORDER BY e.tenant_id
